advantage_gate.bootstrap_units: Distinct questions stratified by repository/primary stratum, paired arms and repeat blocks kept together
advantage_gate.comparators: Each applicable direct-context and search_git baseline, not just weaker arm
advantage_gate.each_repository: No lower answer pass or recall than stronger applicable plaintext comparator
advantage_gate.inconclusive: Unresolved confidence bounds or inadequate power remain inconclusive; no post-result gate change
advantage_gate.report: Output tokens, latency, total costs, failed attempts, indexing/update costs and measured break-even; input-token savings alone are not a monetary savings claim

arms.required: Real FalkorDB query traces; no disabled-graph results counted as graph
Iterative plaintext search, revision show, exact-span file reads and Git-history/merge inspection at every slice; comparable development effort recorded
Same raw corpus only where exact total serialized context fits; retain explicit overflow attempts, still compare search_git everywhere

authorship.assistance: AI-generated source/Git review and oracle authoring; no human review or signature asserted
authorship.independence: No product code, implementation tests, old evaluation questions/answers/results, or generated product outputs used. No product invoked. Fresh Click source inspected only by independent evaluator in this phase.
authorship.parent_attestation: Parent reports no Click source/oracle inspection; final implementation and unseen trial attestation remain pending.

budgets.graph_server_scanned_rows: Not equated with returned rows; requires separate database observability if claimed
budgets.input_unit_definition: Provider/model-tokenizer measured tokens including instructions, questions, accumulated retrieval/tool outputs and failed attempts; bytes/rows never substituted for tokens
budgets.row_unit_definition: Evidence output row is one returned source/commit fact unit after pagination; internal graph rows count every row delivered by the driver including later filtered/deduplicated rows, across all nested reads. Raw source bytes count all fetched source before excerpt filtering.
budgets.usable_single_prompt_input_formula: min(per-question input ceiling, model context window - output reserve - future-tool reserve - exact fixed prompt overhead); publish full-window comparison too

corpus.available_to_arms: Identical immutable raw Git objects and included production Python/packaging/release-note corpus; no oracle/scoring annotations.
corpus.excluded: tests/, examples/, generated docs, vendored requests/packages/ implementation parsing; unsupported languages not silently parsed.
corpus.included: requests/, src/requests/, click/, src/click/ production .py excluding requests/packages/; root packaging metadata and HISTORY/CHANGES/CHANGELOG metadata; all Git ancestry/tree/ref metadata.
limits: Dynamic calls/module aliases are not complete
No runtime execution or compatibility pass
Historical Python-2 syntax may be unparsed and must expose gaps
corpus.roots: All exact snapshot SHAs and all reachable ancestor commits in the corpus manifest; additional oracle commit IDs are pinned in the task manifest and independently verified reachable.
supported_relations: CALLS inferred with declared static resolution limits
corpus.token_calculation_required: For each slice/repository publish the serialization of included unique blobs + source identifiers + complete commit/tree membership metadata and model-exact token count; reserve output/tool tokens explicitly. No approximation substituted for actual tokenizer/provider count.

environment.cold_state: Fresh independently named empty graph and importer/retrieval cache; DB/process state and filesystem cache handling recorded. Warm state measured separately.
environment.credentials: Existing authenticated provider accounts required; credentials never enter artifacts.
environment.provider_readiness: evals/confirmatory/provider-readiness.draft-v1.json; listings are metadata only, not model selection or generated results

fairness.budgets: Same token/output/tool/time/source-byte ceilings; interface-specific rows disclosed
fairness.caching: No result/answer cache. Model provider prompt caching and retrieval caching explicitly recorded; cache benefit cannot change evidence availability.
fairness.decoding: Identical per arm; temperature/top_p/seed/reasoning settings pending
fairness.development_tuning: No held-out questions/answers used to tune core, search baseline or prompts. If holdout informs any change it becomes development data; new confirmatory cases required.
fairness.model_and_answer_instructions: Identical per arm; exact versions/hashes pending
fairness.retries: No silent retries; all attempts counted against same task budget; failed pairs retained

freeze.amendments: Every pre-result change creates a new version/hash and review. Every post-result change requires a new evaluation preserving previous plans, attempted runs and results. Holdout-informed changes consume those holdouts.
freeze.canonical_hash_rule: SHA256 of exact UTF-8 plan bytes; detached manifest lists every referenced artifact hash. Plan does not contain its own hash.

mandatory_pending_before_frozen_signatur: Final complete core before/after hash attestation and unseen Click implementation/tuning isolation
Exact prompt files/hashes and comparable baseline implementations/tuning effort
Exact corpus serialization/token count and beyond-context comparison
Pilot development-data power/sample-size rationale for Gate B
Named two independent blind scorers and third adjudicator with prompt/model identities
Runner permission/allowlist proof excluding sealed files
Independent frozen-plan review/signature before any confirmatory result

repeats.unsupported_seed_policy: Record nondeterminism; retain all three paired attempts

scale_slices.policy: All ancestors per root. Supplemental direct-context comparisons use declared smaller file/commit slices only when the complete identical raw slice fits; never silently trim evidence.

scoring.aggregation: Average 3 repeats within each question, then macro-average distinct questions; publish every run, repo and stratum.
scoring.alternative_proofs: Narrower/adjacent source spans or equivalent Git plumbing accepted only if they prove every needed proposition with exact identity; earlier/later source alone is not an alternative. Record adjudication.
scoring.answer_pass: All required conclusions correct, material claims supported, citations resolve, required uncertainty/clarification included. Invented conclusion or wrong revision fails.
scoring.blinding: Response IDs randomized; remove arm/tool branding from scorer view while retaining source citations/provenance. Scorers cannot infer arm from an ID key; retain hidden mapping.
scoring.clarification_only_evidence: Only the eight predeclared IDs are evidence N/A; count separately. Their answer/negative-case gates still apply.

double_score.agreement: Retain both original ratings, percent agreement and disagreements; independent third reviewer adjudicates with recorded rationale.
double_score.extra_required: Every disputed, wrong-revision, fabricated/false-pass case and all its repeats, beyond base sample

scoring.evidence_unit: One exact source (repo,commit,path,start,end,full-file SHA256) unit or a Git commit/tree/diff/ancestry object proof. Merge duplicated exact identity tuples/commit IDs before denominator calculation.
scoring.failure_denominators: Timeout/error/unjustified abstention answer=0 and recall=0. Empty retrieval on answerable case precision=0. Failed attempts never dropped.
scoring.precision: Relevant deduplicated retrieved units / all deduplicated retrieved units; relevant means supports the question or a necessary reasoning step
scoring.recall: Required facts supported by retrieved evidence / all required facts
scoring.required_fact_unit: Individual oracle proposition with revision-specific evidence; alternative proof must support same proposition at exact pinned state
scoring.retrieval_before_answer: Raw retrieval/evidence trace locked and hash-recorded before answer generation

sealed_oracle.access_rule: No implementer/ingestion/retrieval/model answer role may open sealed files or author scripts. Only isolated scoring roles consume the frozen oracle after raw retrieval and answers are locked.
sealed_oracle.contents: Required facts, exact commit/path/line spans and full-file hashes, Git commit/tree/diff provenance, acceptable alternative evidence, required uncertainty and incorrect claims.
sealed_oracle.isolation_limit: Directory is a logical access boundary between agent roles, not a cryptographic/OS boundary against the same-account parent; verify runner allowlists and absence of oracle reads before running.

supersedes_draft: draft-v1 remains preserved; v2 clarifies budget units and adds final draft roster/scorer sampling and stronger explicit branch-source fact rubrics before any results.

tasks.complexity_count_policy: Conservative count uses only REL/BRN/FIX/IDN cross-revision cases, not potentially dynamic DEP chains.
